note: An optional count: given one, the note is the whole empty state, shown only while that list is empty

component.doc: A quiet line of muted text, inset 4 dp to line up with a card's rounded edge: what a section says while its list is empty (give count the list's query, {query_key, where?}, and the note shows only while that list has no rows), or a hint under a heading. Secondary text by default; for a heading above a card use core:section_label.

params.name: style
params.doc: A core://Text style (Caption for a smaller hint).

params.name: count
params.doc: A list's count query, {query_key, where?}, as a core://Conditional's count: the note shows only while it is 0. Left out, the note always shows.

examples.note: an empty section: shown only while the open tasks list is empty

args.text: Last hour · last day · since the server started

examples.note: a small hint under a section's heading
